name: Jehdeiah
title: Overseer of King David's female donkeys
summary: Jehdeiah was a Meronothite who served under King David as the overseer of the female donkeys. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles 27:30 as one of David's trusted officials responsible for royal property. He held a practical yet important administrative role in David's kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as overseer of the female donkeys
keyEvents.description: Jehdeiah, the Meronothite, was placed in charge of the female donkeys belonging to King David. This was an important administrative position in the united kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's administrative system
keyEvents.description: Jehdeiah was one of several overseers who managed King David's properties and livestock, reflecting a well-organized kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Served among David's trusted officials
keyEvents.description: Along with other officials such as Obil, who oversaw the camels, and Jaziz, who oversaw the small livestock, Jehdeiah was part of the king's trusted stewards.

keyEvents.title: Management of royal property
keyEvents.description: Jehdeiah was part of the system where different men were placed in charge of various parts of David's possessions, including vineyards, olive groves, and livestock.
